name: Collusion Resistant Verification Requires History Controls
text: Attack-resistant verification architecture must address endogenous verifier collusion as well as majority capture, because reward structure, peer behavior, verification feedback, and accumulated interaction history can jointly induce protocol deviation, while restricting the amount and scope of accessible history may reduce that risk.
scope_conditions: reward incentives conflict with protocol compliance
history restriction is a reported mitigation signal, not proof of complete prevention
The position is Kaal's own cross-domain application of the cited claim; the source's authors do not make it.
The source passage is taken from the arXiv abstract; the full paper was not reviewed.
